evaluation_basis: Assessed against the preregistered untouched 8h Binance Vision holdout and incremental feature-family gates; the spent holdout is not retuned.
original_objective: Test whether Ichimoku and point-in-time funding/premium/order-flow/OI features add net alpha over price-only models on an external perpetuals holdout.

engineering_result.summary: All 12 symbols, point-in-time derivative features, fixed models, explicit costs, bootstrap/FDR and immutable artifact production completed successfully.

scientific_result.summary: Neither full nor derivatives-only learned variants established positive incremental alpha over price-only; the external holdout was frozen as spent.

economic_result.summary: Logistic price-only -5.19%/Sharpe -0.192; full -5.85%/-0.298; price+derivatives -16.58%/-1.395. Full-minus-price-only CI [-0.000640, +0.000447], q=0.9468.

limitations: Kline taker-buy proxy rather than reconstructed fine microstructure
Three seeds were effectively deterministic for the tested estimators
Holdout cannot be reused for tuning
contribution_to_next_version: Closed this holdout honestly and redirected work to prospective microstructure/forward evidence rather than tuning a negative result.
